data.name: KamiKaZe
data.detailed_description:
Grab a controller, call your friends, and get ready to yell. KamiKaze is a couch-fueled, chaos-blasted, 4-player local multiplayer shooter where every round is a new story of betrayal, laughter, and explosive comebacks. With only 3 minutes on the clock, anything can happen—and usually does.

What Is KamiKaze? It’s a neon-soaked free-for-all brawler where you spawn with a Rifle, a Pistol, and your trusty Katana—and then the mayhem begins. Use quick reflexes, grab unpredictable powerups, and make every second count as you blast, slice, and bounce your friends off the map.

🎮 Game Modes:

🔥 DeathmatchWelcome to the main event. Everyone vs everyone. No mercy.

  • Win Condition: Most kills in 3 minutes.

  • Health Madness: Every kill drops a health pack. Oh, and every 60 seconds your health gets swapped with someone else. Good luck!

  • Powerups Include:

    • Golden Gun: One shot. One kill. No pressure.

    • Anti-Gravity Gun: Send your enemies soaring.

    • Paintball Gun: Splatter them with chaos.

    • Giant Gun: Get hit and you turn into a giant. Yes, really.

🚩 Capture the Flag One flag. Random spawn. Pure chaos.

  • How It Works: A single flag spawns randomly. Kill the flag bearer to claim it. Hold it when the clock hits 0 and you win.

  • No Limits: Bring whatever weapons and powerups you can find. Fair play? Nah.

  • Strategize or Sabotage: Camp the flag? Rush in headfirst? Or let your “friends” fight while you swoop in at the last second?

🗺️ Maps & Mayhem: From neon-lit rooftops to tightly-packed city streets, each arena is built for one thing: maximum chaos in minimum time. Every map is designed for fast movement, sneaky ambushes, and unforgettable moments.

Why You’ll Rage-Laugh With KamiKaze:

  • 🔥 Perfect for parties, roommates, or rivals.

  • 💣 3-minute rounds = nonstop action.

  • 🎯 Pure skill? Pure luck? Who cares—it's FUN.

  • 🤯 Powerups that flip the script every match.

Whether you're hunting for glory, revenge, or just hilarious highlight clips, KamiKaze delivers ridiculous fun, punchy gameplay, and the kind of couch co-op chaos that ruins friendships—in the best way possible.

Let the screaming begin. 👊

data.short_description: KamiKaZe is a controller-only multiplayer shooter where it's every player for themselves—no teams, just pure free-for-all action! Each player needs their own controller: whether it’s a 1v1, a three-player showdown, or a full four-player brawl.Grab your controllers and prove who’s the best!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
